panels.title: Today by Symbol

targets.rawSql:
WITH sym(underlying, loss_limit, ord) AS (VALUES ('SPX', 500.0, 1), ('NDX', 500.0, 2), ('XSP', 50.0, 3)),
t AS (
  SELECT underlying, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl > 0) AS wins,
    SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) AS pnl, MAX(pnl * 100 * quantity) AS best, MIN(pnl * 100 * quantity) AS worst,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_time - entry_time))) AS hold
  FROM butterfly_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND underlying IN ('SPX', 'NDX', 'XSP') AND trade_date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date GROUP BY underlying
),
r AS (SELECT underlying, realized_pnl, halted FROM daily_risk_state WHERE trade_date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date),
per AS (
  SELECT s.ord, s.underlying AS "Symbol",
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.halted, false) THEN 'HALTED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS "Status",
    COALESCE(t.n, 0)::float AS "Trades", COALESCE(t.wins, 0)::float AS "Wins",
    COALESCE(t.pnl, 0)::float AS "P&L", t.best::float AS "Best", t.worst::float AS "Worst",
    t.hold::float AS "Avg Hold",
    (s.loss_limit + COALESCE(r.realized_pnl, 0))::float AS "Loss Limit Left",
    LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, -100 * COALESCE(r.realized_pnl, 0) / s.loss_limit))::float AS "Limit Used"
  FROM sym s LEFT JOIN t USING (underlying) LEFT JOIN r USING (underlying)
)
SELECT "Symbol", "Status", "Trades", "Wins", "P&L", "Best", "Worst", "Avg Hold", "Loss Limit Left", "Limit Used"
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM per
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 9, 'Total', NULL, SUM("Trades"), SUM("Wins"), SUM("P&L"), MAX("Best"), MIN("Worst"),
    (SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_time - entry_time))) FROM butterfly_trades
     WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND underlying IN ('SPX', 'NDX', 'XSP') AND trade_date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date)::float, NULL, NULL
  FROM per
) x ORDER BY ord

panels.description: Per-symbol results and daily loss-limit headroom. Limits: SPX $500, NDX $500, XSP $50.

targets.rawSql: SELECT id AS "Trade", entry_time AS "Entry", exit_time AS "Exit", underlying AS "Symbol", direction AS "Side", center_strike::float AS "Center", wing_width AS "Width", (entry_price * 100 * quantity)::float AS "Cost", (peak_value * 100 * quantity)::float AS "Peak Value", (exit_price * 100 * quantity)::float AS "Exit Value", (pnl * 100 * quantity)::float AS "P&L", (100 * pnl / NULLIF(entry_price, 0))::float AS "Return", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_time - entry_time))::float AS "Hold", initcap(replace(COALESCE(exit_reason, 'unknown'), '_', ' ')) AS "Exit Reason" FROM butterfly_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND underlying IN ('SPX', 'NDX', 'XSP') AND trade_date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::date ORDER BY entry_time DESC

panels.title: Performance by Symbol

targets.rawSql:
WITH tr AS (
  SELECT underlying, exit_time, id, (pnl * 100 * quantity) AS p FROM butterfly_trades
  WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND underlying IN ('SPX', 'NDX', 'XSP') AND $__timeFilter(exit_time)
),
all_tr AS (SELECT * FROM tr UNION ALL SELECT 'Total', exit_time, id, p FROM tr),
cum AS (
  SELECT underlying, exit_time, id, p,
    SUM(p) OVER (PARTITION BY underlying ORDER BY exit_time, id) AS c
  FROM all_tr
),
peak AS (
  SELECT underlying, p, c,
    GREATEST(0, MAX(c) OVER (PARTITION BY underlying ORDER BY exit_time, id)) AS hi
  FROM cum
)
SELECT underlying AS "Symbol",
  COUNT(*)::float AS "Trades",
  (100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p > 0) / COUNT(*))::float AS "Win Rate",
  SUM(p)::float AS "Net P&L",
  AVG(p)::float AS "Avg / Trade",
  AVG(p) FILTER (WHERE p > 0)::float AS "Avg Win",
  AVG(p) FILTER (WHERE p < 0)::float AS "Avg Loss",
  (SUM(p) FILTER (WHERE p > 0) / NULLIF(-SUM(p) FILTER (WHERE p < 0), 0))::float AS "Profit Factor",
  MAX(p)::float AS "Best", MIN(p)::float AS "Worst",
  MIN(c - hi)::float AS "Max Drawdown"
FROM peak GROUP BY underlying
ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['SPX', 'NDX', 'XSP', 'Total'], underlying)

panels.description: Closed trades that exited inside the dashboard time range. Max drawdown is the largest peak-to-trough drop in cumulative closed-trade P&L.

targets.rawSql: SELECT exit_time AS time, SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) OVER (ORDER BY exit_time) AS "SPX" FROM butterfly_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND underlying='SPX' AND underlying IN (${equity_symbols:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) ORDER BY exit_time

SELECT exit_time AS time, SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) OVER (ORDER BY exit_time) AS "NDX" FROM butterfly_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND underlying='NDX' AND underlying IN (${equity_symbols:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) ORDER BY exit_time

SELECT exit_time AS time, SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) OVER (ORDER BY exit_time) AS "XSP" FROM butterfly_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND underlying='XSP' AND underlying IN (${equity_symbols:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) ORDER BY exit_time

SELECT direction, COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='SPX'), 0)::float AS "SPX P&L", COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='NDX'), 0)::float AS "NDX P&L", COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='XSP'), 0)::float AS "XSP P&L" FROM butterfly_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) GROUP BY direction ORDER BY direction

SELECT wing_width::text AS wing_width, COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='SPX'), 0)::float AS "SPX P&L", COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='NDX'), 0)::float AS "NDX P&L", COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='XSP'), 0)::float AS "XSP P&L" FROM butterfly_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) GROUP BY wing_width ORDER BY wing_width

SELECT COALESCE(exit_reason, 'unknown') AS exit_reason, COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='SPX'), 0)::float AS "SPX P&L", COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='NDX'), 0)::float AS "NDX P&L", COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='XSP'), 0)::float AS "XSP P&L" FROM butterfly_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) GROUP BY exit_reason ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='SPX'), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='NDX'), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(pnl * 100 * quantity) FILTER (WHERE underlying='XSP'), 0)) DESC

SELECT id AS "Trade", trade_date AS "Date", entry_time AS "Entry", exit_time AS "Exit", underlying AS "Symbol", direction AS "Side", center_strike::float AS "Center", wing_width AS "Width", (entry_price * 100 * quantity)::float AS "Cost", (peak_value * 100 * quantity)::float AS "Peak Value", (exit_price * 100 * quantity)::float AS "Exit Value", (pnl * 100 * quantity)::float AS "P&L", (100 * pnl / NULLIF(entry_price, 0))::float AS "Return", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_time - entry_time))::float AS "Hold", initcap(replace(COALESCE(exit_reason, 'unknown'), '_', ' ')) AS "Exit Reason" FROM butterfly_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' AND ('$fill_model' = 'all' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'paper_fill_model', 'legacy') = '$fill_model') AND underlying IN ('SPX', 'NDX', 'XSP') AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) ORDER BY entry_time DESC
